collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager paints a new pattern along the side of a canoe.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (name1) paints a new pattern along the side of a canoe. The pattern looks like waves, and the canoe seems faster already.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (name1) paints a new pattern along the side of a canoe. A child adds a small fish to the end, and (name1) decides to keep it.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) paints a new pattern along the side of a canoe. The paint is still wet when someone tries to launch the canoe.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) paints a new pattern along the side of a canoe. (name1) steps back and decides it is the best painting (name1) has ever done.
